text: Seedance 2.0 is brilliant. Pair it with Grok and it's a lethal combo. If 5–10 of us team up, we could basically make Inception 2. We might even get Leonardo DiCaprio on board... he's one prompt away. https://t.co/CWGXCKrrJQ
content:
Use Grok to generate frames, then animate them in Seedance 2.0.  
Upscale Seedance 2.0 outputs with Topaz Labs.  
Edit and apply color correction in CapCut after generating/upscaling.

translations.es:
Usa Grok para generar fotogramas, luego anímalos en Seedance 2.0.  
Mejora las salidas de Seedance 2.0 con Topaz Labs.  
Edita y aplica corrección de color en CapCut después de generar/mejorar.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Hilo 1] @grok frames ↴ 
Seedance 2.0 animation ↴ 
@topazlabs upscale ↴
@capcutapp edit + color correction.

Éditez et appliquez une correction des couleurs dans CapCut après la génération/l'amélioration.

--- CONTINUATION DU FIL ---
[Fil 1] @grok frames ↴ 
Animation Seedance 2.0 ↴ 
@topazlabs upscale ↴
@capcutapp édition + correction des couleurs.
